reason: The new loop in app/controllers/uploads_controller.rb:41-46 calls OptimizedImage.downsize(tempfile.path, tempfile.path, "80%", allow_animation: false). That uses the non-animated downsize_instructions at app/models/optimized_image.rb:126-134, which runs `convert #{from}[0] ... #{to}` with from == to, so only the first frame is written back over the uploaded GIF. The animated path also needs a .gif path (optimized_image.rb:155), and the temp upload path may not have one, so the animation may be lost even with the setting on.
